title: 第二百二十四章 出奇的投缘第二百二十三章 陆母的纠结
slug: 新婚夜反杀家暴男极品全家求我别疯
content_zh:
这边小笨鸡焯好水刚下锅，房门就被敲响了。
陆方源面色一喜，忙把手上的水渍在围裙上蹭了蹭，然后颠颠地去开门。
还不忘回头叮嘱媳妇，“不许使脸色，听见没？”
冯秋梅‘哼’了一声，把两盘水果端到茶几上。
她好歹是读过书、受过高等教育的人，老陆怎么把她想得这么不堪？
推开门一看，就见铮儿跟何丫头站在外面。
陆方源高兴坏了，忙侧过身去，“快进来快进来，哎哟，这怎么还买这么多东西啊，家里什么都不缺，何丫头能来叔叔就很高兴啦！”
何浅浅怔了怔神，她完全没想到陆叔叔会这么热情，急忙鞠了一躬，“陆叔叔好，上次离别后，我一直想来看看您呢！”
“好，这次过来，干脆在家里过完年再回去吧，还有几天就是春节了！”陆方源笑着邀请。
“爸......”陆铮无奈地看了老爹一眼，“浅浅还有一大家子人要团聚呢，况且徐厅长被抓后，她母亲也要回北春了，多年未见，怎么着也得让她们母女二人过一个团圆年吧！”
浅浅不是不想留下，她是真的抽不开身。
“是是是！”陆方源憨笑一声，“是我想得太片面了，丫头进屋吧，不用换鞋了！”
冯秋梅坐在沙发上，抻着脖子往门口这边看。
见何浅浅大大方方的走进来，冯秋梅居然有一丝紧张。
这女孩长得水嫩嫩的，眼眸潋滟如水，个子也有一米六五左右，身材高挑匀称，行为得体大方，气质比她预想得要好很多。
完全不像一个低学历的女孩。
何浅浅放下东西，上前鞠躬行礼，“阿姨好，我叫何浅浅，是陆铮的女朋友！”
一听到‘女朋友’这三个字，站在旁边的陆铮心里乐开了花。
他跟浅浅相处这么久，这还是浅浅第一次当着爸妈的面，承认是他的女朋友。
冯秋梅站起身，抿嘴笑笑，“经常听我家老陆提起你，今日一见，何丫头果然很有气质呢，上次老陆去北春出差，承蒙你的款待了，快坐下吧，吃点水果！”

“谢谢阿姨！”何浅浅笑眼弯弯地坐在沙发上。
冯秋梅瞥了眼茶几上的燕窝和阿胶，不禁摇头，“这东西多贵啊，你拿回去给你母亲吃吧！”
“妈！”陆铮皱了皱眉，“这东西是浅浅专程给你挑选的，回去后我会给顾阿姨买礼物的！”
“丫头有心了！”冯秋梅上下打量着何浅浅。
居然很顺眼，不是那种没见过世面的女孩，而且这丫头到了家里一点也不胆怯。
打扮得清爽利落，眼神带着笑容，却又藏着一丝凌厉和不易察觉的冷。
也难怪铮儿会喜欢她，这样一个长得又漂亮又能挣钱、还能帮国家抓敌特的女孩，谁不喜欢呢？
陆方源用眼睛瞄着媳妇，见她没说难听的话，便伸手招呼儿子，“铮儿，来厨房，给爸打打下手，让你妈跟浅浅唠嗑！”
“好！”陆铮脱掉棉衣，去卫生间洗了洗手，然后一步三回头地走进厨房。
陆家的房子是军区分的，并不太奢华，好在足够宽敞。
content_en:
The little stupid chicken here was blanched in water and just as soon as it was put into the pot, there was a knock on the door.
Lu Fangyuan looked happy and hurriedly wiped the water stains on his apron, then went to open the door with a bang.
He didn't forget to turn around and tell his wife, "Don't show your face, do you hear me?"
Feng Qiumei hummed and put two plates of fruit on the coffee table.
After all, she was a well-educated and highly educated person. Why did Lao Lu think so badly of her?
When he opened the door, he saw Zheng'er and He Yatou standing outside.
Lu Fangyuan was so happy that he turned around quickly and said, "Come in, come in, oh, why are you buying so many things? There is nothing missing at home, and uncle is very happy that He Yatou can come!"
He Qianqian was stunned. She didn't expect Uncle Lu to be so enthusiastic. She bowed hurriedly, "Hello, Uncle Lu. I've been wanting to come and see you since we left last time!"
"Okay, come here this time, why don't you go back after celebrating the New Year at home? The Spring Festival is in a few days!" Lu Fangyuan invited with a smile.
"Dad..." Lu Zheng glanced at his father helplessly, "Qianqian still has a whole family to reunite with. Besides, after Director Xu was arrested, her mother is going back to Beichun. She hasn't seen her for many years. No matter what, we have to let them have a reunion year!"
It's not that Qian Qian doesn't want to stay, she really can't get away.
"Yes, yes!" Lu Fangyuan laughed naively, "I thought too one-sidedly, girl, please come in, there's no need to change your shoes!"
Feng Qiumei sat on the sofa, stretched her neck and looked towards the door.
Seeing He Qianqian walking in openly, Feng Qiumei actually felt a little nervous.
This girl was tender and tender, with eyes as bright as water. She was about 1.65 meters tall, with a tall and well-proportioned figure, decent and generous behavior, and a much better temperament than she expected.
She doesn't look like a low-educated girl at all.
He Qianqian put down her things, stepped forward and bowed, "Hello, aunt, my name is He Qianqian, I am Lu Zheng's girlfriend!"
When he heard the word 'girlfriend', Lu Zheng, who was standing next to him, felt happy.
He and Qian Qian have been together for so long, and this is the first time Qian Qian admits that she is his girlfriend in front of her parents.
Feng Qiumei stood up, pursed her lips and smiled, "I often hear my Lao Lu talking about you. When I meet you today, He Yatou is indeed very elegant. Last time Lao Lu went to Beichun on a business trip, I thank you for your hospitality. Come sit down and eat some fruit!"
"Thank you, Auntie!" He Qianqian smiled and sat on the sofa.
Feng Qiumei glanced at the bird's nests and donkey-hide gelatin on the coffee table and couldn't help but shake her head, "How expensive are these things? Take them back and give them to your mother!"
"Mom!" Lu Zheng frowned, "Qianqian specially selected this thing for you. I will buy a gift for Aunt Gu when I get back!"
"Girl is interested!" Feng Qiumei looked at He Qianqian up and down.
She is actually very pleasing to the eye, she is not the kind of girl who has never seen the world, and this girl is not timid at all when she comes home.
He was dressed neatly and neatly, with a smile in his eyes, but there was a sharp and imperceptible coldness hidden inside.
No wonder Zheng'er likes her. Who wouldn't like such a beautiful girl who can make money and help the country catch enemy agents?
Lu Fangyuan glanced at his wife, and when he saw that she didn't say anything unpleasant, he stretched out his hand to greet his son, "Zheng'er, come to the kitchen, help dad, and let your mom chat with Qian Qian!"
"Okay!" Lu Zheng took off his cotton-padded clothes, went to the bathroom to wash his hands, and then walked back into the kitchen.
The Lu family's house is located in the military area. It is not too luxurious, but fortunately it is spacious enough.
